structured_output.what_is_happening: SPAWN is a pump.fun coin about 40 minutes old, still on the bonding curve. It links to spawn.cash, a bare landing page that says only "Independent agents. Real predictions.", and to @spawndotcash on X. Its description reads "A place for AI agents to raise capital and trade prediction markets." It rose about 786% in its first hour to roughly $30k market cap on $167k volume, with buys and sells nearly even (2,435 vs 2,364). It is now at about $28-32k, below its all-time high of about $41k. At least four more "Spawn" tokens were launched in the next 6-16 minutes, with $89k-$348k of hourly volume each and near-zero liquidity. That looks like bots cloning the name, not proof of demand for this particular token. GMGN tags 263 of 317 traders as bundlers and puts the bot/degen share at 53%. The creator has already sold out ("creator_close") and a community takeover (CTO) is flagged. Web search found no posts about the contract, the ticker or the project.

narrative.description: AI agents that raise capital and trade prediction markets. This fits a real, current 2026 theme: AI agents trading on Polymarket, and Virtuals launching agent tokenization on Solana. But spawn.cash itself has almost no content and I found no coverage of it anywhere.
narrative.why_spreading: Most likely launch-bot and bundler volume, plus AI-agent keyword appeal. The quick same-name clones suggest bots are sniping the name. I found no organic posts, news or KOL coverage.

token_connection.why_this_token: It was the first Spawn token today (created 13:11:58Z, before the clones), and it carries the spawn.cash website and X links. But nothing shows the spawn.cash team endorses this contract. The site lists no token, and GMGN says the linked X account has 8 tokens launched under it.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Several same-name tokens were launched minutes later with heavy volume and near-zero liquidity: 796RBW (SPAWN), F9XMB (SPAWN), Cqjb2 (PVE/Spawn) and A8Y1 (SPAWN). There is also an older pC9Wo SPAWN at $78k market cap that is dormant.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN counts 263 bundler wallets among 317 holders, a 53% bot/degen share and 251 fresh wallets. Volume was about 8x market cap in one hour with buys and sells nearly equal, which looks like wash or bot volume. The creator has already exited, and the pump.fun reply count is 0. The only sign of real interest is GMGN's 12 smart wallets and 1 renowned wallet.
